page.layout: One text column, full width, with the running head and page number at the top and the catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: “voir , que ces examens sont necessaires à “ceux qui se rendent juges de la Doctrine “de l’Eglise, & qui establissent leur foy sur “leur propre lumiere, & sur la recherche “qu’ils pretendent avoir faite dela verité; & “que par consequent , on à droit de leur de-“mander , qu’ils lisent toutes les pieces du “procez, dont ils s’establissent juges, & qu’ils “ne forment pas leur decision sur le rapport “d’une des parties.

Rebus ad hunc modum stantibus, videtur humanitùs impossibile, ut per prædicationem novorum Lutherorum, Zuingliorum, & Calvinorum, integræ nationes deinceps pertrahantur & pervincantur, ad se aggregandum ad reformatorum coetus, & se à Papa abscindant : licet non negaverim, plures privatæ sortis homines post primam illam defectionem à Papa per eam prædicationem ab eo descivisse, non tamen magno Papæ dispendio ; cum per defectionem subinde nostrorum ad eum, illud abundè resarciant dispendium.

5. Cum ergo hodie propter has causas & per has artes, imperium Papale terrenum sit longè firmum & in solido locatum, tametsi arctioribus cancellis & limitibus conclusum quam fuit ante Lutherum ; non est per tot volumina à nostris edita, & quæ quotidie publici juris sunt ad confutanda delira-menta Romanensium Doctrinarum, is expectandus successus qui sit operæ pretium ; sed aliâ viâ & ratione aggrediendum est opus

page.notes: The handwritten "186" at top right is not printed and is left out. The word after "tametsi" is printed "metsiarctioribus" and is read here as "tametsi arctioribus"; the first letters are doubtful. The French quotation lines are each introduced by a printed opening quotation mark. Some French spellings ("etablissent", "pretendent") are copied as printed, with the accents missing from the scan.
